description: InSQL tag metadata from Tag, AnalogTag and EngineeringUnit, and History read in Delta mode or sampled in Cyclic mode.
unverified: History.wwRetrievalMode and History.wwResolution: InSQL adds these retrieval keywords to a History query; they are not physical columns.
AnalogTag.MinEU and AnalogTag.MaxEU: some InSQL versions expose limits as MinEU/MaxEU, others keep them only in the tag definition.
Tag.Description: older InSQL schemas store the description in AnalogTag.Description instead of Tag.Description.
QUALITY: QualityDetail 192 is the documented good code; the other ranges follow the OPC quality bit pairs and need confirmation on the site.

browse.sql: SELECT t.TagName, t.Description, u.Description AS Unit FROM Tag t JOIN AnalogTag a ON a.TagName = t.TagName LEFT JOIN EngineeringUnit u ON u.EngUnits = a.EngUnits ORDER BY t.TagName

metadata.sql: SELECT t.Description, u.Description AS Unit, a.MinEU, a.MaxEU FROM Tag t JOIN AnalogTag a ON a.TagName = t.TagName LEFT JOIN EngineeringUnit u ON u.EngUnits = a.EngUnits WHERE t.TagName = ?

history.sql: SELECT DateTime, Value, QualityDetail FROM History WHERE TagName = ? AND DateTime >= ? AND DateTime <= ? AND wwRetrievalMode = 'Delta' ORDER BY DateTime
history.period_sql: SELECT DateTime, Value, QualityDetail FROM History WHERE TagName = ? AND DateTime >= ? AND DateTime <= ? AND wwRetrievalMode = 'Cyclic' AND wwResolution = ? ORDER BY DateTime

latest.sql: SELECT DateTime, Value, QualityDetail FROM History WHERE TagName = ? AND wwRetrievalMode = 'Delta' ORDER BY DateTime DESC LIMIT 1
